selection_rule: Newest active EIA-861 annual ZIP on the producer page, plus the newest TIGER annual directory with one exact national COUNTY ZIP; no older-edition fallback.

join.normalization: Unicode compatibility decomposition, ASCII folding, case folding, ampersand to 'and', and removal of non-alphanumeric characters.
join.dissolve: Union of current TIGER county-equivalent polygons in native EPSG:4269.

boundary_precision: County-level approximation. Dissolved current TIGER county equivalents, not utility-owned legal boundaries. Connecticut legacy counties map to every overlapping planning region and are coarser than other states. A bare county name resolves to the county only; an independent city with the same name is included only when EIA lists its separate 'X City' row, and an unlisted name collision fails the join.
source_scope: All EIA-861 utility-by-county service-territory rows for the selected annual release, excluding only the source 'Not Applicable' county sentinel.
open_decisions: historical HIFLD/ORNL baseline and population equivalence
legal-boundary precision and state/utility crosswalk acceptance
